reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/runtime.rs owns scoped wait and mask guards. IoWait owns a counter contribution and RestoreMask owns the saved signal-mask value; read_interruptible borrows its caller buffer and descriptor.
owner_creation.invariant: Input buffers and FDs are not acquired by this module.
limitations: RestoreMask owns a saved mask value, not a kernel resource allocation.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/runtime.rs borrows caller buffers only during read. The raw buffer is lent to libc::read only for the synchronous call; guard Drop balances nested waits and restores the original mask on Rust return.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A read must return before its caller buffer owner moves.
limitations: Caller buffers must remain valid until the synchronous read returns.

callback_targets.analysis: src/runtime.rs converts signal dispositions at rless_signal. Rless_signal at 26-40 converts optional function values through sigaction; SIG_ERR and prior sentinel integers are transmuted into Rust function-pointer representations (M0-SIG-004).
callback_targets.invariant: Signal sentinels still lack a distinct typed representation.
limitations: rless_signal sentinel conversion remains separately open under M0-SIG-004.

invalidation.analysis: src/runtime.rs requires registered code to outlive kernel use. The RAII mask survives until read exits, but retained kernel handler addresses outlive rless_signal and must be stable image functions.
invalidation.invariant: Signal registration outlives its stack sigaction struct.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/runtime.rs blocks signals before testing notification state. Blocking handled signals precedes checking IO_INTERRUPTED and ppoll atomically restores the saved mask while waiting; SA_RESTART is deliberately disabled.
mutation_commit.invariant: Read interruption does not depend on a check/read gap.

release_pair.analysis: src/runtime.rs restores masks and wait counts on return. RestoreMask Drop restores the previous mask while preserving errno; IoWait Drop decrements the active count. No read path closes the borrowed FD.
release_pair.invariant: Guard cleanup must run through ordinary Rust frames.
limitations: Guard Drop restores state on Rust return, not on arbitrary process exit.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/runtime.rs returns errors through guard destruction. Sigprocmask/ppoll/read errors return normally so guards run; failed sigaction returns the unresolved function-pointer error sentinel rather than a typed Result.
error_cleanup.invariant: Mask cleanup is explicit while sentinel errors remain hazardous.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/runtime.rs does not make translated handlers owner-safe. The atomic protocol avoids nonlocal jumps; it does not repair callback representation or the translated handlers that mutate/free pager state.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-SIG-004 prevents a clear signal-boundary disposition.
limitations: Raw buffer validity and the single-reader assumption remain caller contracts; M0-SIG-004 is open and no production code is changed.
